dad.sentence: Timmy's father is very important to him. He goes everywhere with his dad.

daily.definition: Used to describe something done every day.

damn.definition: You say damn when you are angry or surprised about something.

dance.definition: If you dance, you move your body to music.
dance.sentence: My husband and I like to dance at home to the radio.

dare.definition: If you dare to do something, you have the courage to do it, even if you are afraid.
dare.sentence: I dare you to climb that tree.

dark.definition: If something is dark, is has no light.

darkness.definition: The state of being dark; no light.
darkness.sentence: He moved off into the darkness.

data.definition: Data is information, such as facts, numbers, photographs, etc.
data.sentence: A study using experimental data from ten schools found no difference between methods.

database.definition: A database is a collection of information arranged neatly.
database.sentence: I have a huge database of all the employees in my company.

date.definition: A date is a particular day in a month or year.
date.sentence: Charles suggested they get together at a later date to sort it out.

daughter.definition: A daughter is a female child of someone.
daughter.sentence: I am her father and she is my daughter.

day.sentence: They put on two performances every day.

deal.definition: A deal is a business agreement.
deal.sentence: The company made a deal with the agents.

dealer.definition: A dealer deals or sells things.

dear.definition: Dear is something that is precious or greatly valued to someone. They love the thing or the person.
dear.sentence: My large stamp collection is very dear to me.

death.definition: The end of life and existence.

debate.definition: A debate is an exchange of ideas looking at different sides of an issue.
debate.sentence: The government's spending programme is the subject of much heated debate.

debt.definition: An item or money which belongs to another, and which will be repaid (given back) in the future.

decade.definition: A decade is a period of 10 years.

decide.definition: If you decide something, there were different things you could do, but you choose one.

decision.definition: A decision is a sudden thought, with purpose, before someone does something. After a person makes a decision, the person has knowledge about a thing the person will do.
decision.sentence: After much thought, the person made a decision to go to the meeting.

declare.definition: If you declare something, you say it publicly or officially.

decline.definition: If something declines, it goes down in number, quality, slope, or value.
decline.sentence: The number of students studying foreign languages continues to decline.

decrease.definition: If something decreases, it goes down in number or value.

dedicate.definition: To specially set apart for a god or for religious purposes.

deep.definition: A hole or body of water is deep if it goes down a long way.
deep.sentence: Do not dive into this swimming pool because it is not deep enough.

deeply.definition: If something is deeply rooted, felt, held, etc., it is done to a deep extent or degree.
deeply.sentence: I am deeply concerned about this matter.

defeat.definition: If you defeat someone, you win against them in a game, battle, or contest.

defend.definition: To remove an attacker; to protect your things and/or allies.

defense.definition: Defense is the process of protecting.
defense.sentence: The secretary of defense met with the president at the White House.

deficit.definition: A deficit is a lack or shortage of something, such as money.
deficit.sentence: New blood vessels bud out from the already dilated vascular bed to make up the nutritional deficit.

define.definition: If you define a word, you state exactly what the word means.

definitely.definition: Something that will definitely happen will happen without doubt or with great chances of occurring.
definitely.sentence: The letter will definitely come this week.

definition.definition: A definition is an explanation of the meaning of a word.
definition.sentence: The sentence before this one is a definition.

degree.definition: We measure an angle using degrees. All the way around a circle is 360 degrees. Often, ° is written instead of "degrees".
degree.sentence: To what degree do the two accounts of the accident agree?

delay.definition: A delay is a wait or the waiting time.
delay.sentence: Computer problems caused a long delay in the meeting.

delight.definition: Delight is the feeling of being very happy.
delight.sentence: There was a real sense of relief when the war ended and great delight that it had stopped.

deliver.definition: If you deliver something, you bring it to the person or place where it belongs.
deliver.sentence: A promise from the government doesn't mean that they will actually deliver.

delivery.definition: A delivery is the act of moving good or mail from a source to somebody.
delivery.sentence: The delivery of the letters was delayed by the weather.

demand.definition: Demand for something is how much people want of it.
demand.sentence: Right now we have a supply in excess of demand for crude oil, gasoline, and heating oil.

democracy.definition: Democracy is a system of government where everyone is equal and everyone has some power. It is a system of government in which the people elect their leaders.
democracy.sentence: Democracy is the will of the people.

democratic.definition: Something that is democratic is based on or relates to democracy, where the people choose the government.
democratic.sentence: The United States is a democratic country, since the citizens choose the leaders in government.

demonstrate.definition: If you demonstrate something, you show that it is true or that it exists.
demonstrate.sentence: In this job, you must demonstrate an ability to communicate effectively.

demonstration.definition: A demonstration of something is the act of showing that it is true or that it exists.
demonstration.sentence: He gave the customer a demonstration.

density.definition: Density is how much stuff fits in a particular area.
density.sentence: The population density of Singapore is one of the highest in the world.

deny.definition: If you deny something, you say it didn't happen or isn't true.
deny.sentence: Why would you go to work and deny yourself a little rest?

department.definition: A department is a part of a business, school, hospital or other institution that has a particular job.
department.sentence: The Department of Health is planning to build three new hospitals in the area.

depend.definition: When you depend on something, you need it; you rely on it; you trust it.
depend.sentence: I knew I could depend on you to meet your aunt at the station.

dependent.definition: If you are dependent on something, you need it or rely on it.
dependent.sentence: Ocean divers are dependent on their oxygen masks for air.

deposit.definition: If you deposit something, you put it down in a place.
deposit.sentence: Deposit the suitcase on the bench.

depress.definition: If you depress something, you push or hold it down.

depression.definition: If someone has depression, they have a condition which makes them very sad and makes it very hard for them to imagine being happy later.
depression.sentence: After Suzie's dog passed away, she fell into a depression for six months.

depth.definition: The distance below a surface; how deep something is.
depth.sentence: Measure the depth of the water in this part of the bay.

derive.definition: If X is derived from Y, X comes from Y in the way that one idea comes from another.

describe.definition: If you describe something, you say what it looks like, sounds like, acts like, etc.
describe.sentence: The instructions describe how to put it together.

description.definition: A statement that represents something in words.
description.sentence: After coming back from Costa Rica, he gave me a long description of the swimming and sight-seeing he did there.

desert.definition: A desert is a bare area of land, especially one with little water or plants.

deserve.definition: When someone deserve something, it means he is good enough to have the privilege of getting something special.
deserve.sentence: You deserve a gift from me since you often treat me well.

design.definition: Design is how something looks and works.
design.sentence: Honda has a new engine in design.

designer.definition: A designer is someone who designs something.
designer.sentence: The costume designer quit before the show opened.

desire.definition: A wish, a feeling of want.
desire.sentence: She has a desire to win.

desk.definition: A desk is a table for studying and writing, usually with drawers.
desk.sentence: The phone on her desk buzzed; Gillian picked it up.

despite.definition: Lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike.
despite.sentence: The despite in which outsiders were held is legendary.

destroy.definition: If a person destroys something, they break it or make it not exist anymore.

destruction.definition: The destruction of a thing is the act of breaking the thing; the end of existence of the thing. Before the destruction, the thing is there. After the destruction, there is no thing any more.
destruction.sentence: The destruction of the house was necessary because the walls were not strong and people were not safe from falling bricks.

detail.definition: A detail is a small part of something that is not as important as the whole thing.
detail.sentence: Writing your name at the top of the page is a small detail, but it's important.

detect.definition: If you detect something, you use your senses to find or notice it.
detect.sentence: These animals have a smell that even a human nose can easily detect.

determination.definition: The act of determining, or the state of being determined.

determine.definition: If A determines the outcome of B, A causes B to occur in a certain way.

develop.definition: When you develop something, you create or make it better.
develop.sentence: The people who are best at anything have to develop their ability over time.

development.sentence: The development of this story has been slow.

device.definition: A device is a small machine or tool.
device.sentence: She has a device in her kitchen for cutting garlic.

devote.definition: If someone devotes time or energy to something, they feel that it is important and they spend a lot of time or energy on it.
devote.sentence: She decided to devote her life to nursing.

dialog.definition: A conversation between two or more individuals.
dialog.sentence: Bill and Melinda maintained a dialog via email over the course of their long-distance relationship.

die.definition: If a person or animal dies, it stops living.

diet.definition: A diet is the food that an animal, person, or group usually eats.
diet.sentence: Studies confirm that vegetarian is a healthful and balanced diet.

differ.definition: If things differ, they are not the same in some way.
differ.sentence: The new cars differ from the old mainly in how they look.

difference.sentence: The difference in her is amazing.

different.definition: Unlike in nature or quality or form or degree.
different.sentence: Took different approaches to the problem.

differently.sentence: The new manager wants to run things differently from before.

difficult.definition: When something is difficult, it is not easy.
difficult.sentence: It'll be difficult to get him to change his mind; he's really stubborn.

difficulty.definition: The difficulty of something is how hard it is to do.
difficulty.sentence: The student finished the homework with great difficulty.

dig.definition: If you dig a hole, you make it bigger by removing material, usually using a shovel or your hands.
dig.sentence: You will need to dig the hole larger than the roots of the tree you want to plant.

digital.definition: Having to do with digits (fingers or toes); performed with a finger.

dimension.definition: A dimension is a part of a problem, issue, or situation.
dimension.sentence: The baby has added a new dimension to our lives.

dinner.definition: Dinner is the largest meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
dinner.sentence: I'm sorry, I'll be late tonight, so I won't be home for dinner.

direct.definition: If something is direct, it is straight and as short as possible with nothing extra in between.
direct.sentence: It's a direct flight from Tokyo to Toronto with no stop in Vancouver.

direction.definition: A direction is a way to move or point.

directly.definition: If something happens directly, it happens with nothing in between.
directly.sentence: I don't think we'll be directly affected by these changes.

director.definition: A director is a person who is in charge of something.
director.sentence: The film director was doing a very good job.

dirty.definition: If something is dirty, it has dirt on it, or it is not clean.
dirty.sentence: After playing outside all day, her hands were all dirty.

disagree.definition: If you disagree, you do not agree. When two people disagree with each other, they have different ideas. They do not believe the same things are true.

disappear.definition: If something disappears, it becomes impossible to see.
disappear.sentence: She watches her two grandchildren until they disappear from sight.

disappoint.definition: If something disappoints somebody, it makes them unhappy because it was not as good as they expected.
disappoint.sentence: We thought the party would be good and it didn't disappoint.

disaster.definition: A disaster is a serious problem.
disaster.sentence: Feed the Children has been involved in disaster relief around the world.

discipline.definition: A disciplined attitude is a controlled behaviour; self-control.
discipline.sentence: In what discipline is his doctorate?

discount.definition: If you discount something, you lower its price.

discover.definition: To find a new idea that was not known before, or to find a thing that was not known about before.

discovery.definition: A thing or an idea that was found.

discussion.definition: A discussion happens when two or more people share ideas about something, usually by talking.
discussion.sentence: The book contains an excellent discussion of modal logic.

disease.definition: If a person, animal, or plant is ill, it has a disease.

dish.definition: Dishes are the flat round holder for food that we usually put on the table and eat off of.
dish.sentence: Last night she made a wonderful Indian dish that I had never eaten before.

disk.definition: A disk is an object that is thin, flat, and circular.
disk.sentence: A coin is a disk of metal.

dismiss.definition: When you dismiss someone from a company, you fire and end the employment of the person, causing the person to become unemployed.
dismiss.sentence: The parade commander stepped forward to ask the President for permission to dismiss the parade.

disorder.definition: Absence of order; a condition of not being arranged in an orderly manner.
disorder.sentence: The children left the room in disorder.

display.definition: A display is an exhibition, an arrangement, or a show.
display.sentence: Mom thought the department store's display of lingerie was indecent.

dispute.definition: A dispute is an argument or disagreement which continues over a period of time. A dispute may escalate into violence, or it may be a long verbal and legal struggle.
dispute.sentence: India and Pakistan have a dispute over Kasmir.

distance.definition: The distance between two things is how far apart they are. A short distance means they're close to each other, and a long distance means they're far apart.
distance.sentence: The two girls were sitting a short distance apart, so they could hear each other whisper.

distant.definition: Distant is far away; at a distance.
distant.sentence: She liked to travel to distant places.

distinct.definition: If two things are distinct, they are clearly different or separate.
distinct.sentence: Sports psychologists recognized that there were two distinct types of athletes who could become gold-medal winners.

distinction.definition: A distinction is a difference that you have noticed or decided is important. Often used to separate things.
distinction.sentence: There is, in other words, no neat or clear distinction to be drawn between political equality and social and economic equality.

distinguish.definition: When you distinguish something, you are trying to make it easy to sort the item out.
distinguish.sentence: I can't distinguish Jan from Jane because their names are so alike.

distribute.definition: When you distribute something, you divide it and give it out.
distribute.sentence: Please distribute this poster to all the people on that list.

district.definition: A district is an area of land that shares certain characteristics.
district.sentence: The lake district is one of England's most beautiful areas.

disturb.definition: If you disturb someone, you stop them from doing something, often by talking to them or making noise.
disturb.sentence: Don't disturb the patient's wounds by moving him too rapidly!

diversity.definition: Diversity is the property of having many different kinds of things or people.
diversity.sentence: Racial diversity is very low in Japan and very high in Toronto.

divide.definition: When you divide a thing you separate it into two or more other things.
divide.sentence: The children divide their books so they all have at least one.

division.definition: Division is the act of dividing a whole thing into parts.
division.sentence: The division of the pie by the children happened with very little fighting.

divorce.definition: Divorce is the legal ending of a marriage.

do.definition: Do is an auxiliary verb. It is used in questions, negative statements, short answers, and for emphasis when there is no other auxiliary.
do.sentence: I've got a lot to do.

doctor.definition: A person who helps people who are sick, and looks after their health.
doctor.sentence: I felt so bad I went to see my doctor.

document.definition: A document is a written record, often official.
document.sentence: Can you send me that document by e-mail or fax?

dog.definition: A dog is a domestic mammal, related to wolves and foxes, that is often kept as a pet.

dollar.definition: The basic monetary unit in many countries; equal to 100 cents.
dollar.sentence: The dollar coin has never been popular in the United States.

domestic.definition: Domestic issues relate to issues inside one country, not affecting other countries.
domestic.sentence: He believes the public is ready for change in domestic and foreign policy.

dominate.definition: If someone dominates something, they have sole, or nearly complete, control over it.

door.definition: A piece of a wall that can be opened (leaving a hole in the wall to walk through) or closed (covering the hole). Some doors are on hinges; others slide.
door.sentence: Please open the door for him. His hands are full.

double.definition: A double door, window, etc. includes two of the same kind.
double.sentence: We opened the double door to let the piano come in.

doubt.definition: A doubt is a question or uncertainty about something.

down.definition: Down is soft feathers or a covering of soft feathers.
down.sentence: That pillow is full of down.

dozen.sentence: He ate half a dozen cookies and felt sick.

draft.definition: A draft is a piece of writing which has been or may be edited.
draft.sentence: In the first draft of the story the characters names are all different.

drag.definition: If you drag something, you pull it, usually with difficulty.
drag.sentence: Dad sent me to drag you back home.

drama.definition: A drama is a serious story for TV, stage, radio, etc.
drama.sentence: The courtroom drama stars Melissa Gilbert as a young lawyer.

dramatic.definition: If something is dramatic, it is large and sudden.
dramatic.sentence: The increase in foreign students has meant a dramatic change in the number of schools.

dramatically.definition: If something is done dramatically, it is done in a dramatic way.

draw.definition: When you draw, you use a pencil, pen, crayon, etc. to make a picture.

dream.definition: Dreams are the images and things you see when you are sleeping.
dream.sentence: In my dream I had forgotten the baby in a drawer.

dress.definition: A dress is a loose cloth covering a woman's body. The lower part is like a skirt. The top part is like a shirt.
dress.sentence: She looked beautiful because she had a very nice dress.

drink.definition: A drink is a liquid that you take in through your mouth.
drink.sentence: He served her a hot drink and some cake.

drive.definition: If you drive a car or other vehicle, you control its movement and direction.
drive.sentence: I've been learning how to drive a bus.

driver.definition: A driver is a person who drives.
driver.sentence: That man is a driver of cars.

drop.definition: A drop is a very small amount of a liquid.
drop.sentence: There was a drop in the prices last week.

dry.definition: If something is dry, it has no water or liquid on it.

due.definition: If something is due, it should happen at a particular time.
due.sentence: Your homework is due on Tuesday.

dust.definition: Dust is a thin powder that can be seen in the air or on a surface.
dust.sentence: The old building was filled with dust.

duty.definition: A duty is something that you should do.
duty.sentence: Parents have the duty to educate their children.
